methodology.sourceBinding: Future frozen checkout clean HEAD plus sorted tracked executable paths and NUL-delimited bytes; manifest and wrapper hashes checked separately.
methodology.publicOnly: Every admitted proposition must exactly match its case allowlist. Every outgoing Exa search/objective/nested highlight instruction is checked against imported public-span helpers and strict known fields before reservation or fetch.
methodology.logging: Original input and credentials are excluded from public reports; only declared public spans and bounded recognized target-status fields are retained.
methodology.comparison: Corrected offline comparator keeps stance >=0.8 separate from substantive-content/common-origin assessment >=0.85; identical material fingerprints only. This is not a full policy or source-verification decision.
